mail.reason: MAIL_SINK_TO not set — refusing unsolicited mail send

blockers.dependency: Controlled notification sink / allowlisted audit inbox
blockers.action: Provide MAIL_SINK_TO (or confirm admin SMTP test recipient is an audit-only mailbox) and prove interception before invitation/signing/withdrawal/billing notification cases.

blockers.dependency: Confirmed isolated staging DB/tenant (AUDIT_ISOLATION_CONFIRMED=1) or dedicated staging host
affected: All mutating journeys (J04–J20, withdrawals, deletions, invitations, sandbox checkout)
blockers.action: Operator confirms customer-data isolation and test-provider routing on this host, then set AUDIT_ISOLATION_CONFIRMED=1 for the audit agent — or provide a dedicated staging URL.

blockers.dependency: Remove default admin credential rendering from /admin/login
blockers.action: Hotfix: stop rendering concrete default credentials on the login page. Validate rejection via isolated auth unit/regression tests — do not attempt exposed password on live admin.

isolation.note: influrios.com is not presumed isolated. Mutations require confirmed sandbox providers + mail sink.
